parsed.reason: The message correctly attributes readiness to the parent ('You told me', 'I'll take your word for it') without verifying anything. It names only Max, asks nothing, is in English and gets the portal and account right. Restating the four setup items as what 'done' means is fair. Two small issues hold it back from a 5: 'his birthday' assumes a gender the facts don't give, and the checklist recital reads a bit stiff for a friendly text.
